translations.text: [?]He who intends to read me may find in me, if he greatly desires it, a good example of spiritual life,
so that he may very easily ascend to the heavenly home, where there is always hope and joy, bliss in the cities, for those who may see the Son of God himself with their own eyes.
The man whose mind is sound may obtain that, if he then believes in his heart in the help of these saints and follows their example, as this book says.
Bishop Wulfstan ordered me to be written, servant and needy one of him who [?] all majesty, and who is also ruler of every creature, the one eternal God of all creation.
The bishop who obtained this book, which you now hold in your hands and look at, asks you to pray to these saints, whose memory is recorded here, for help for him,
and that God Almighty, who has power over all the kingdom, may forgive him the sins he once committed and also grant him rest with Him; and likewise for his ring-giver, who gave him this exemplar,
that is, Alfred among the English, the best giver of treasure of all the kings he has ever heard tell of, later or earlier, or of any earthly king he has ever learned of before.
